address: Plazuela de los Capuchinos 2, Segovia, 40001, Spain
bio: Occupying the former church of the Convento de las Oblatas, the restaurant has been tastefully and elegantly updated to combine the historic structural elements with the most modern aesthetic details. Here, always with integrity and a high level of technical ability, they are committed to local produce, with innovative dishes based on tradition that only reach the diner through two set menus (Esencia and Gran Manú)....
